We're recruiting a PhD student to join the lab in September 2027, to work on **"Cooperation and conflict under warming: how does temperature shape social behaviour in bees?"**

Climate warming is predicted to shift the balance between cooperation and conflict in animal societies, yet evidence for this effect is still scarce. This project will investigate how warming shapes social behaviour in bees, combining behavioural experiments in the field with statistical ecology.

The project would suit someone with an interest in animal behaviour and quantitative or statistical approaches to ecology. It is a funded Queen Mary University of London studentship, co-supervised with Eleni Matechou in the School of Mathematical Sciences. *Please note that applicants must be eligible for UK home fees.*

**Deadline: 27 January 2027**

[Full details and how to apply on FindAPhD](https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/cooperation-and-conflict-under-warming-how-does-temperature-shape-social-behaviour-in-bees/?p203261)

Informal enquiries are welcome: email [m.ostwald@qmul.ac.uk](mailto:m.ostwald@qmul.ac.uk).
